Add your own folders, such as sample collections on external drives, by dropping them into Places or with Add Folder. Live scans them, with a spinning wheel while it works.
Adding doesn't move the folder. A moved, renamed or disconnected folder shows grayed out; use Locate Folder, or Remove from Sidebar to forget it.
Scroll with the arrow keys, the mouse wheel, or Cmd+Option-drag (Mac) / Ctrl+Alt-drag (Win).
Left and right arrows open and close folders and move between the sidebar and the content pane.
Opening a folder closes the others unless you hold Cmd (Mac) / Ctrl (Win).
Turn on the Preview toggle at the bottom of the browser to hear samples, clips and instrument presets when you select them. Without it, Shift+Enter or the right arrow previews the selected item.
The Preview tab shows a waveform; click it to jump. Clips saved with Warp off can't be scrubbed.
With Raw off, the default, previews start on the next bar while the transport runs and loop. With Raw on, they play at their original tempo, unlooped and unscrubbable.
The Main track's Preview/Cue Volume knob sets the level. An interface with a spare pair of outputs lets you cue previews in headphones while the main mix plays.
4.10 Adding Content from the Browser to a Live Set
Drag items onto Session or Arrangement tracks; dropping them right of the Session tracks or below the Arrangement tracks creates a new track.
4.10 Adding Content from the Browser to a Live Set

In Session View, double-click or Enter loads a device onto the selected track; a sample goes into a Simpler on a MIDI track or into a clip slot on an audio track. In Arrangement View, the same loads the item onto the selected track.
